name: Forrest County, MS
findings: Forrest County has 208 nonprofit organizations. 90 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 76 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Forrest County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 19 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
